title: Go where selfishness can soften
summary: True congregation leads the heart to the Lord, loosens selfishness, and lets peace merge like water in water.
takeaway: Go where selfishness can dissolve into peace.
lifeApplication: When you start brooding alone, physically move toward sangat: the gurdwara, the call, the elder, the friend who makes truth easier. Do not let private weather make the next decision.

source.shortMeaning: Sat Sangat turns the heart toward the Lord until selfishness gives way and peace merges like water in water.
source.lifeApplication: When private weather thickens, move toward the company that makes surrender easier than brooding.

evidence.coreClaim: Sat Sangat turns the heart toward the Lord until selfishness gives way and peace merges like water in water.
evidence.turn: Let true company make surrender more natural than self-protection.
